criterion: which assistant-command intent the utterance expresses, that is what the user wants done

categories.name: Query General Information
categories.definition: User asks for facts, definitions, general knowledge, comparisons, how-to instructions, or information about products or services.

categories.name: Query Personal Status
categories.definition: User asks for personal information, account details, financial status, health status, schedule, to-do list, reminders, or travel status.

categories.name: Query Local Search/Recommendation
categories.definition: User asks for nearby places, recommendations for activities, food, or services.

categories.name: Query Current Conditions
categories.definition: User asks for real-time information such as weather, traffic, time, or general flight status.

categories.name: Query About Assistant
categories.definition: User asks questions about the assistant's identity, capabilities, feelings, or origin.

categories.name: Query Media Information
categories.definition: User asks for details about currently playing media or specific media content.

categories.name: Control Device/System
categories.definition: User commands the assistant to adjust settings, control media playback, or manage device functions.

categories.name: Manage Schedule/Reminders
categories.definition: User commands the assistant to set, clear, or modify calendar events, appointments, alarms, or reminders.

categories.name: Perform Financial Transaction/Service
categories.definition: User commands the assistant to transfer money, pay bills, apply for financial products, or report financial issues.

categories.name: Communicate/Notify
categories.definition: User commands the assistant to send messages, make calls, share location, or inform others (e.g., bank of travel).

categories.name: Book/Order/Reserve
categories.definition: User commands the assistant to make, change, or cancel reservations, book travel, or order items.

categories.name: Search/Find Item
categories.definition: User commands the assistant to actively search for specific items, recipes, articles, prices, or locate a device.

categories.name: Use Utility/Game
categories.definition: User commands the assistant to perform a simple utility function or play a game.

categories.name: Request Ride Hailing
categories.definition: User commands the assistant to request a ride service.

categories.name: Request Navigation
categories.definition: User commands the assistant to provide directions.

categories.name: Track Item/Service
categories.definition: User commands the assistant to track a delivery or service.

categories.name: Manage Service
categories.definition: User commands the assistant to start, stop, or change a recurring service.

categories.name: Generate Content
categories.definition: User commands the assistant to create text, lists, or other content.

categories.name: Correct/Undo
categories.definition: User corrects the assistant's previous action or output, or requests an undo.

categories.name: Greeting/Farewell
categories.definition: User initiates or ends a conversation with the assistant.

categories.name: Affirmation/Acknowledgement
categories.definition: User provides a simple affirmative response or expresses gratitude.

categories.name: Informative Statement
categories.definition: User makes a statement of fact or observation without expecting a direct action or information retrieval from the assistant.

categories.name: Ambiguous/Unclear Intent
categories.definition: The user's intent is not clearly discernible as a specific command or query.
